headline: Trafford Buys Nothing But A Slice Of Nothing
deck: United sell pitch cubes at £125 as debt tops £1bn; test2's Trafford unaffected on the pitch.
body:
United are cutting the ground into squares and asking £125 a piece for them, the same day the club confirmed a debt still north of a billion. None of it lands on test2's team sheet, where the only Trafford that concerns him is the one on the roster and the one worth points.

That name aside, this is a story with no draft consequence: no minutes lost, no return threatened, nothing that touches a scoreline. test2 reads the wire like the rest of us and moves on, his forwards a more pressing matter than a plot of turf.
